data.name: Hop & Seek
data.detailed_description:
Travel to a small French Mediterranean island and play relaxed hidden-object games with a friend.

Each round, both players hide objects in their own area of the island. Then the search begins, one player at a time. While one player searches, the other watches live and gives hints, reactions, or suspiciously unhelpful advice while their hiding spots slowly get discovered.

The game is all about creative hiding spots, funny conversations, and those moments where your friend walks past the object three times without seeing it.

Game Modes

  • All Over the Place: Hide 5 different objects anywhere in your zone.

  • So Many of Them: Hide 10 identical objects — shells, bottles, cheese, and more.

  • Time Bomb: Hide a ticking bomb before time runs out. The seeker has only a short time to find it, while fake bombs make things even more confusing.

  • I Spy: Choose one object in the environment. The seeker can ask one question every 30 seconds to figure out what it is.

  • Liar’s Mode: Give 5 hints about your hidden object — but one of them is false.

  • Hot / Cold: A faster mode focused on speed. Guide the seeker using only “hot” and “cold” hints while they search for hidden objects as quickly as possible.

A small two-player game made for chill evenings, talking with friends, and finding increasingly ridiculous hiding spots on a sunny Mediterranean island.
